offering_description.value: Provides independent investment research, fund and stock ratings, market data, indexes and investment analysis software to investment professionals, financial advisers, companies and individual investors. It sells mainly through subscriptions, data licenses and fees for software, and also manages investment portfolios for clients.

primary_products.value: investment research reports; fund and stock ratings; investment analysis software; market indexes; credit ratings

primary_services.value: investment management; investment consulting; private market data services; retirement planning tools

customer_segment.value: B2B: asset managers, financial advisers, banks, insurers, pension funds, wealth managers, corporations; B2C: individual investors using its research and investment tools; B2G: government agencies buying data or research

end_markets.value: financial services; asset management; wealth management; retirement planning; capital markets

revenue_model.value: subscription: subscriptions to research, data and software platforms; licensing or royalties: licenses for use of its indexes and ratings data; commissions or management fees: fees on assets under management in its investment portfolios; service fees: consulting and advisory fees from clients
revenue_model.category: subscription; licensing or royalties; commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: investment analysis platforms sold to financial professionals and firms; service provider: research, ratings and advisory services sold to investors and institutions; financial intermediary: manages investment portfolios on behalf of clients
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: Operates in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and other regions with offices worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: investment research, data and indexes, investment software, credit ratings, and investment management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to institutional clients and firms; online: website and online platforms for individual investors and subscribers; partners / resellers: data distribution partners and financial platform providers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Investment adviser registration with the SEC and credit rating registration as a nationally recognized rating organization, EU and other securities rules apply
